purpose: maintain the health of production databases through planned, safe, reversible maintenance
entry_criteria: Maintenance needs are identified from monitoring (bloat, fragmentation, growth, statistics)
procedure: Identify the work from metrics: index maintenance, statistics, vacuum or compaction, storage growth, version patches.
Rehearse on a copy and record duration and locking effects.
Confirm a verified backup exists and obtain the DBA owner's approval for the window.
Run the maintenance with monitoring and stop conditions; stop if thresholds are crossed.
Verify health metrics and query performance afterward against the baseline.
Record what was done and schedule the next review.
acceptance_criteria: Metrics improved or stayed within limits

validation.command: psql -c "SELECT relname, n_dead_tup FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC LIMIT 10"   # example for PostgreSQL

validation.check: compare p95 query latency before and after the window

failure_modes.detection: Rehearsal or run shows long locks
failure_modes.response: Use online methods or schedule later
Roll back where possible or apply the prepared fix

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A weekend window rebuilds three bloated indexes online. Rehearsal showed no long locks; afterward the table's dead tuples drop and p95 latency is unchanged.
